syl: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏳ ᏧᎾᏍᎪᏎ ᏗᎦᎾᏗᏫᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᏅ
pho: hí'a ani:tsalagi hawí:ni:yu tsunsgó:se'i digandiwisv’i hí'a ú:sdi ganv:nv´
eng: The Cherokees dug a deep pit across the trail

syl: ᏃᏊᏗ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏃᏔᏁᎢ ᎾᎥᏂ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᏅ
pho: nogwudi é:gwa tsunó:tané:'i na'v´hni ú:sdi ganv:nv´
eng: Then they built a big fire near the trail

syl: ᏃᏉᏗᏍᏉ ᏣᏂᎧᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏊ ᏓᎦᎷᏥᏒ ᏍᎩᎾ. ᎭᎪᏘᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᎧᏒᏍᏗ.
pho: no:gwodísgwo tsaní:gtahé: i:yú:gwu dagalú:tsisv´: sgína ago:tísgv:'i tsuksv´:sdi.
eng: They knew she would come as soon as she saw the smoke.
